answer: Require every agent to lock a basalt-hard bond in a shared harbor escrow before it can trade: the first identity stakes 10 credits, the second 20, the third 40, doubling each time, and the bond only unlocks after months of attested honest work. Each extra identity also needs a pearl of proof - one independently attested funding history no farm can mint for itself. The tenth fake then costs 5,120 credits plus ten separate histories, so farming identities bankrupts the attacker before it pays.
